read_multiple_files.desc: Read several files in one call with compact per-file headers. Use instead of repeated read_file for related files, especially after narrowing with grep_files or search_files. Shared or per-file line windows are supported for sampling large files; each failed file is reported inline without aborting the batch; BOM-marked UTF-16 is decoded automatically; binary files return summaries unless include_base64=true. You can pass explicit paths, or use root+glob to bulk-read a matched file set in one round trip.

params.paths: Optional array of file paths or {path, start_line?, end_line?, head?, tail?, ranges?, show_line_numbers?, max_bytes?} objects, in output order. Provide this, a glob, or both.
params.max_bytes_per_file: Shared maximum bytes returned per file. Default: 131072 (128 KB). Non-positive values keep the default. Keep in mind that even 128 KB of text can consume many tokens.
params.total_max_bytes: Shared maximum rendered output bytes across the whole batch. Default: 524288 (512 KB). Set 0 for unlimited; negative values use the default. Large full-file batches are still expensive even when output is capped, so prefer ranges/head/tail or smaller batches when exploring.
params.include_base64: For binary files, include capped base64 bytes in addition to metadata. Default: false.
params.root: Root directory used when glob is set. Defaults to the current working directory.
params.glob: Optional basename glob for bulk reads, such as *.go or *.{ts,tsx}. Matches are appended in walk order after any explicit paths.
params.recursive: When glob is set and root is a directory, descend into subdirectories. Default: true.
params.show_hidden: When glob is set, include hidden files and directories. Default: false.
params.exclude_patterns: When glob is set, prune basenames such as .git, node_modules, dist, build, vendor, or generated outputs before reading.
params.start_line: Shared first line to read, 1-indexed. Used when per-file ranges/head/tail are not set.
params.end_line: Shared last line to read, inclusive. If omitted with start_line, reads through the end of each file.
params.head: Shared first-N-lines window to apply to every string path entry.
params.tail: Shared last-N-lines window to apply to every string path entry. When combined with head, returns the last N lines of the shared head window.
params.show_line_numbers: Shared flag to prefix output lines with source line numbers. Default: false.
params.ranges: Shared array of [start_line, end_line] pairs for non-contiguous snippets. Takes precedence over shared head/tail/start_line/end_line.

write_multiple_files.desc: Create or overwrite several files atomically per file in one call. Use for generated bundles or coordinated edits when full file contents are known. Parent directories are created by default; any per-file failure makes the overall tool result an error while still reporting successes. Set all_or_nothing=true to stage the whole batch and avoid partial workspace updates.

params.files: Non-empty array of {"path": "...", "content": "..."} objects. Content is the complete file content for each path.
params.create_dirs: Create missing parent directories before writing. Default: true.
params.show_diff: Include a unified diff for each written file when old content can be read. Default: false to avoid flooding context.
params.all_or_nothing: Stage every file first and only commit the batch if they all succeed. Default: false.

find_replace_in_files.desc: Find and replace text across a file tree. Use for scoped mechanical replacements after previewing with dry_run=true. Skips binary files, can skip oversized files, preserves CRLF line endings, and supports Go regex with $1/$2 replacement captures.

params.path: Root file or directory to process.
params.old_str: Text or Go regex pattern to find. Required.
params.new_str: Replacement text. May be empty to delete matches; use $1/$2 back-references when use_regex=true.
params.use_regex: Treat old_str as a Go regular expression. Default: false.
params.recursive: Descend into subdirectories when path is a directory. Default: true.
params.glob: Only process files whose basename matches this glob, such as *.go or *.{ts,tsx}. Strongly prefer setting this in large projects.
params.dry_run: Preview matches and diffs without modifying files. Default: false; run this first for broad replacements.
params.show_diff: Include unified diffs for changed files. Default: false; enable it when reviewing a narrow replacement set.
params.show_hidden: Include hidden files and directories. Default: false.
params.exclude_patterns: Basename globs to prune before processing, such as node_modules, .git, vendor, dist, build, or generated files.
params.show_unmodified: List files that were scanned but had no match. Default: false; leave false unless you need an audit trail.
params.max_file_size: Skip files larger than this many bytes. Default: 10485760 (10 MB); set 0 for unlimited. Negative values use the default.
params.max_total_diff_bytes: Maximum total diff bytes to emit when show_diff=true. Default: 262144 (256 KB); set 0 for unlimited. Negative values use the default.

path_exists_batch.desc: Check existence/type/size for many paths in one call. Use before batch reads/writes or cleanup decisions instead of repeated path_exists calls; symlink targets are described when available.

params.paths: Non-empty array of file, directory, or symlink paths to check.
params.limit: Maximum paths to return. Default: 500; set 0 for all. Negative values use the default.

get_multiple_file_info.desc: Return metadata for many files/directories/symlinks in one call. Compact mode gives one line per path; details mode gives expanded fields including symlink target metadata when available. Errors are reported inline per path.

params.paths: Non-empty array of paths to inspect.
params.limit: Maximum paths to return. Default: 100; set 0 for all. Negative values use the default.
params.count_lines: Count lines for text files. Default: false; set true only when line counts are actually needed. This scans each counted file fully.
params.output_mode: "compact" (default) returns one line per path; "details" returns expanded labeled fields.

delete_files.desc: Delete multiple non-directory filesystem entries in one call. Each path is processed independently so successful deletions are still reported when another entry fails.

params.paths: Non-empty array of file or symlink paths to delete.

copy_paths.desc: Copy multiple files or directory trees in one call. Directory copies are recursive, reject symlinks inside the tree, and preserve source permissions. Existing destinations require overwrite=true.

params.entries: Non-empty array of {source, destination, overwrite?} objects to copy.
params.overwrite: Shared overwrite default for every entry. Individual entries may override it with overwrite=true/false.

move_paths.desc: Move or rename multiple files or directories in one call. Same-filesystem moves use rename; cross-device fallback copies then deletes the source when needed. Existing destinations require overwrite=true.

params.entries: Non-empty array of {source, destination, overwrite?} objects to move.
params.overwrite: Shared overwrite default for every entry. Individual entries may override it with overwrite=true/false.
